name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - McDonough GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: The Westridge Logistics Center fronts Westridge Parkway with open paved truck-court driveways. z18/z19 satellite and Street View (2022/2025) show no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at any property-line connection, and no perimeter fence around the operational yard. Classed false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No 1-3-vehicle staffed booth at any entrance in z18/z19 satellite or Street View. The office is a multi-bay structure built into the SE building face, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in inference.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large cross-dock distribution building (Westridge Logistics Center) with continuous dock-door banks on both the NW and SE long faces, both lined with trailers; counted ~120 doors total - solidly in the 50+ band. Exact count approximate. GXO leases 204,000 SF within this larger building.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run from two physically separate banks on opposite (NW and SE) building faces, so shipping and receiving operate from separate clusters.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard on the SW side plus trailer rows along both dock faces; well over 50 trailers parked away from active docks - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide truck courts on both dock faces hold queues well over 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: McDonough GA is part of metro Atlanta's exurban fabric (Henry County); the site sits in an established industrial park within a mile of I-75, with residential subdivisions immediately east - Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; truck-served only.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane truck-court entrances and large paved aprons give ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Treated as a single large multi-tenant distribution building; GXO occupies a 204,000 SF portion. Separate neighboring warehouses in the park are off-property and not counted.
